scope: Exact file-set digests and counts only; no measurement rows, paths below the registered roots, run IDs, runtime values, outcomes, patterns or cycles were released.

digest_algorithm.measurement_file_set_sha256: SHA-256 of concatenated sha256sum lines in the fixed six-file order recorded by the v5 job specification.
digest_algorithm.driver_log_file_set_sha256: SHA-256 of concatenated sha256sum lines for all *.driver.log files under the registered root, using ./ relative paths sorted bytewise.
